events.removed_duplicate: ContentView.scenePhase recheck (F2, blocked-only subset of F1) deleted; recheckCameraAccess self-coalesces via recheckTask

events.reaches: active route only: camera route -> reportSceneInactive (idempotent guard); scenes route -> handleDidEnterBackground (single-flight teardown); history -> nothing
events.convergent_view_effects: SETCameraCoachProductionView.scenePhase + SceneGeneratorView.scenePhase (owns dismiss UX) converge on same idempotent owners; dismiss fires once
events.fixed_gaps: legacy OverlayView path had NO background stop (capture leak); scenes route hook had NO caller (dead)

events.rationale: no guaranteed background time; durable state via project snapshots; recording kill-recovery is M7/BL-P0-16 scope
